verdict.rationale: Gemini API does not host a standard llms.txt (confirmed 404 probe), but it does ship 'Gemini API Skills' — a documented, installable skill file designed specifically to give coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, etc.) access to up-to-date docs and best practices, which is an agent-oriented docs mechanism. This is a narrower, vendor-specific alternative rather than the open llms.txt convention. Missing for 10: an actual llms.txt or equivalent open standard file, an OpenAPI spec (also 404), and independent confirmation that agents successfully consume the Skills docs in practice.
